languages.label: Languages you can learn with Kolo

how.title: Every word on its own orbit
how.text: Kolo keeps track of how well you know each word and decides when it's time to see it again.

steps.title: Add words
steps.text: Your own — from books, shows and conversations. Paste a whole list in one go.

steps.title: Practise a little
steps.text: Flashcards, quizzes and games. Even five minutes a day counts.

steps.title: Kolo brings them back
steps.text: Hard words return tomorrow, familiar ones in a week or a month. You review exactly what's due.

modes.title: Six ways to make a word stick
modes.text: The same words in different formats — pick the mode that suits your mood.

flashcards.name: Flashcards
flashcards.text: The word on one side, the translation on the other. Mark how well you knew it.

review.name: Daily review
review.text: Only the words that are due today.

quiz.name: Quiz
quiz.text: Pick the right answer, type the word or match pairs.

speed.name: Speed round
speed.text: As many answers as you can in 60 seconds.

survival.name: Survival
survival.text: Three lives. Every mistake costs one.

match.name: Match pairs
match.text: Connect six words with their translations against the clock.

method.title: Perigee knows when to bring a word back
method.text: Perigee is Kolo's review engine. In orbit, the perigee is the point where a satellite comes closest — and that's the moment Perigee brings a word back, just before it fades. After each card you mark how well you know it: hard words return sooner, and the gaps grow as a word settles in. Under the hood is SM-2, a proven spaced-repetition method.

habit.title: A habit you won't want to break
habit.text: Your streak grows with every day you practise. The daily puzzle and achievements give you a reason to come back tomorrow.

streak.title: Day streak
streak.text: Every day of practice extends it.

daily.title: Daily puzzle
daily.text: Make words from seven letters and compare your score with other players.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.text: For streaks, words learned and perfect quizzes.

words.title: Your words, your pace
words.text: Learn the words you actually come across — in books, shows and conversations.

sets.title: Sets and folders
sets.text: Sort words into sets and folders. Paste a whole list and it's imported in one go.

audio.title: Pronunciation
audio.text: Tap to hear a word and its example. Audio works for Norwegian today; other languages are on the way.

words.import: Paste a list — imported in one go

team.title: Built with ❤️ by the Kolo team
team.text: Kolo is a product of Dakuta studio. The designers and developers on the Kolo team build it on three principles: real learning value, careful handling of your data, and an honest model — no ads, no paywalls.

app.title: Learn anytime, anywhere
app.text: Kolo works in any browser and installs on your phone like a regular app — with its own icon, in full screen. Your progress syncs across your devices.

ios.title: iPhone & iPad
ios.hint: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen

desktop.title: Computer
desktop.hint: Any modern browser, nothing to download

native.title: Native iOS and Android apps
native.text: We're building the team and raising the funds to release them. Until then, install Kolo from the browser.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.askText: Write to us and we'll reply by email.

items.a: For anyone learning a foreign language — from complete beginners to people who already speak and want a bigger vocabulary. You build sets from the words you actually need.
Almost any: cards work with any alphabet or script, so you can add words in Spanish, Japanese or Norwegian. Pronunciation is available for Norwegian today; voices for other languages are coming soon.
After each card you mark how well you knew it. Perigee, Kolo's review engine built on the SM-2 algorithm, uses that to schedule the next review: hard words come back sooner, familiar ones later.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Kolo runs in the browser. If you like, add it to your home screen and it opens like a regular app.
Yes. With an account, your sets and statistics are stored in the cloud and sync between your phone, tablet and computer.
